summary: Duplicate identities detected when reinstating returning engineer; laptop re-enrollment and key rotation required
description: Issue summary: Employee returning from 6-month sabbatical (internal ID: 12457) has two identities in SSO after a contractor account was issued during leave. The returning user cannot access some internal repos and the Console due to ambiguity in SCIM-linked attributes. Impact: partial access to internal services (git, console), laptop still enrolled to loaner profile, and team cannot reassign reserved license seat until identities are reconciled. Environment: production SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioner v1.9, device enrollment (Intune) for us-west region. Requested action: reconcile identities, re-enroll corporate laptop, rotate SSH keys and service-account credentials where necessary, and confirm policy for reusing service accounts/license reassignments.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Attempt SSO login with returning employee's corporate email (firstname.lastname@redwood.ai) - login succeeds but user is mapped to 'contractor-12457' SCIM record.
2) Attempt git push to internal repo - permission denied citing 'unknown user id'.
3) Check Okta user list - two entries present: one with SCIM externalId matching employee id and one created as contractor_2025-08 with a separate Okta UID.
4) Inspect device inventory: laptop serial SN-AB1234 is currently assigned to 'loaner-482' profile and shows last checkin 2026-01-22.
5) Attempt to SSH to build host - key rejected because authorized_keys lists old key id tied to contractor account.
logs:
SCIM provisioner error (2026-02-09T14:02Z): 'duplicate_externalId_conflict: user already exists with externalId contractor-2025-08'.
Okta audit (2026-02-09T14:03Z): 'create user contractor-2025-08; SCIM: created by sync-job-7'.
Intune enrollment log: device SN-AB1234 policy mismatch: matched to loaner-profile-2024.
SSH host auth.log: 'sshd: Authentication refused for key sha256:XYZ - key not found in expected identity map'.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses: 1) Contractor identity was created while the employee was on leave, leading to duplicate SCIM records. 2) SCIM sync job doesn't dedupe on email+employeeID in cases where externalId was populated as contractor tag. 3) Device was swapped into loaner inventory and not re-associated to the corporate asset record. Findings so far: SCIM shows two records; search by employee id (12457) returns one record that is inactive, contractor-2025-08 is active. Okta admin console shows 'employeeNumber' field mismatch on the active record. No recent PRs in identity repo indicate a change to dedupe logic. Confluence runbook for reinstatement is out of date regarding externalId reconciliation. Temporary mitigation attempted: created a short-lived mapping script to add the employeeNumber to the contractor record and re-run SCIM sync (sync job 7.4). This allowed Console access but did not fix git SSH key mapping. Next steps: coordinate with Security to rotate host keys and rebind device record; run SCIM merge using authoritative HR feed and mark redundant record for archival.

resolution: Workaround applied: temporarily mapped employeeNumber to the active contractor SCIM record to restore Console access. Long-term fix: performed SCIM authoritative merge of contractor-2025-08 into employee-12457 during maintenance window 2026-02-13 03:00Z; corporate laptop SN-AB1234 reprovisioned and re-enrolled into Intune corp-profile; SSH keys rotated and old keys revoked on build hosts; service account credentials that referenced contractor UID were updated and rotated in KMS. Follow-up: update onboarding/offboarding runbook to include dedupe checks and require an HR reconciliation step before contractor imports. Ticket to close after runbook update (linked PR and confluence doc updated).
